scope: COMMON V2.0 legacy finding revalidation for DRCOM20-001

pdf.visual_note: Page 13 visibly documents InternationalTextType.Value as IBIS-IP.string and InternationalTextType.Language as IBIS-IP.language. The Language type is line-wrapped inside the PDF table cell, which explains the pdftotext tokenization failure seen in the first two EV-136 attempts.

authority.authority_note: Integration-branch bytes match the exact official VDV-301-2.0 tag; no candidate or latest-wins substitution is involved.

visual_fallback.reason: pdftotext splits IBIS-IP.language across lines as 'IBIS-' and 'IP.language'; the exact rendered PNG was therefore inspected directly instead of synthesizing a text match.

finding.claim: PDF InternationalTextType uses IBIS-IP.string / IBIS-IP.language wrapper type notation while the exact official V2.0 XSD declares xs:string / xs:language primitives, producing a material instance-shape boundary.
finding.visual_result: Page 13 confirms the PDF wrapper-type notation.
finding.xsd_result: Exact Common V2.0 declares InternationalTextType.Value as xs:string and Language as xs:language.
finding.validation_behavior: material; consumers must validate against the selected XSD primitive instance shape and must not infer nested IBIS-IP wrapper children from the PDF type labels
